checks.title: 9-Point Email Verification Process
checks.description: ValixMail combines nine real-time checks — from DNS and SMTP to domain age and pattern detection — to guarantee your list is valid and ready for delivery.

items.checkDns: Confirms the domain exists and is properly configured to receive emails.
items.checkDomainAge: Flags newly registered domains commonly linked to spam or fake senders.
items.checkMxRecords: Verifies mail exchange records to ensure active inboxes.
items.checkSmtp: Simulates a live SMTP handshake to confirm real, deliverable addresses.
items.hasSuspiciousPatterns: Detects spammy patterns, fake names, and typo-based addresses.
items.isDisposable: Identifies and blocks temporary or burner email services.
items.isFreeDomain: Detects free providers like Gmail, Outlook, or Yahoo for smarter targeting.
items.isRoleAccount: Recognizes generic inboxes like info{'@'} or support{'@'} that reduce personalization.
items.validateSyntax: Cleans malformed or invalid email formats before they reach your list.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy explains how ValixMail processes data for account creation, email validation, and crypto-based payments.

sections.heading: Information we collect
body: We collect only the information required to operate the email validation service: your account data, CSV uploads, and validation results.
We do not use third-party ad trackers or analytics cookies in this environment.

sections.heading: How we use data
body: Data is processed solely to deliver accurate validation results and improve risk scoring algorithms.
Aggregated, anonymized data may be used to enhance accuracy but is never sold or shared.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You can delete your data anytime by contacting support or clearing your account dashboard.
Full compliance details and subprocessors will be listed in the final production policy.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your access and use of ValixMail. By creating an account or using the platform, you agree to use our email verification tools responsibly, in compliance with applicable data protection and anti-spam regulations.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
body: By accessing or using ValixMail, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.
If you are using ValixMail on behalf of a company or client, you represent that you are authorized to accept these terms on their behalf.
We may update or modify these terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.heading: 2. Permitted Use of the Service
body: ValixMail is designed for legitimate outreach, marketing, and deliverability optimization purposes. You may use our tools to validate and clean email lists that you own or are authorized to process.
You agree not to use ValixMail for sending unsolicited messages, harvesting addresses, or any activity that violates data protection or anti-spam laws such as CAN-SPAM, GDPR, or CASL.
We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access for accounts engaged in abusive behavior, excessive automated requests, or misuse of the validation API.

sections.heading: 3. Payment and Credits
body: All payments are made using USDC (USD Coin) via supported crypto networks. Credits purchased are non-transferable and do not expire unless otherwise stated.
Prices are clearly displayed before each transaction. Refunds may be issued within seven (7) days for unused credits if you are not satisfied with the service.
We are not responsible for delays or failures in blockchain transactions caused by network congestion or wallet misconfiguration.

sections.heading: 4. Data Handling and Privacy
body: Uploaded email data and validation results are processed securely and are never shared or resold. We store only what is necessary to provide and improve the service.
Users must ensure that all uploaded data complies with applicable privacy regulations and that they have obtained any required consent from data subjects.
For detailed information on how we handle data, please review our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 5. Service Availability and Liability
body: ValixMail is provided on an “as-is” and “as-available” basis during the beta phase. We do not guarantee uninterrupted access or error-free performance.
In no event shall ValixMail, its developers, or affiliates be liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use the service.
Users are solely responsible for how they interpret or act upon validation results.
